```ts
const json = (body: unknown, status = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(body), { status, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
globalThis.fetch = (async (input: unknown, init: RequestInit = {}) => {
  const url = String(input);
  const method = init.method ?? 'GET';
  const call: Call = { url, method, body: typeof init.body === 'string' ? JSON.parse(init.body) : null, headers: { ...(init.headers as Record<string, string> | undefined) }, credentials: init.credentials };
  calls.push(call);
  const route = routes[`${method} ${url.split('?')[0]}`];
  if (!route) throw new TypeError(`Failed to fetch: an unexpected request ${method} ${url}`);
  return route(call);
}) as typeof fetch;
const last = (pathname: string) => calls.filter((c) => c.url.split('?')[0] === pathname).at(-1);
const VIEW = (over: Row = {}): Row => ({ telegram: true, google: null, googleFromCalendar: false, email: null, providers: { telegram: true, google: true, email: true }, session: null, ...over });
const methodsOf = (view: Row) => {
  const { session: _session, ...methods } = view;
  return methods;
};

// ---- Mounting ----

let SignInMethods: (props: Row) => ReactElement;
const sheetCalls: ((() => void) | null)[] = [];
const assigned: string[] = [];
const tree = (locale: Locale) =>
  createElement(NextIntlClientProvider, { locale, messages: messages[locale], timeZone: 'Asia/Jerusalem' } as never, createElement(SignInMethods, { userId: 7, onSheet: (close: (() => void) | null) => void sheetCalls.push(close) }));
function open(locale: Locale, view: Row, opts: { telegram?: boolean } = {}) {
  installWindow();
  assigned.length = 0;
  sheetCalls.length = 0;
  fakeWindow.location = { hash: '', origin: 'https://famcal.bot', assign: (u: string) => void assigned.push(u) };
  const tgCalls: string[] = [];
  const tg = opts.telegram ? fakeTelegram(tgCalls, '7.7') : null;
  if (tg) tg.openLink = (url: string) => void tgCalls.push(`openLink(${url})`);
  fakeWindow.Telegram = tg ? { WebApp: tg } : undefined;
  routes = { 'GET /api/signin-methods': () => json(view) };
  const m = mount(tree(locale));
  return { m, tgCalls };
}
const closeAll = (o: { m: Mounted }) => {
  o.m.unmount();
  fakeWindow.Telegram = undefined;
  fakeWindow.location = { hash: '' };
};
const settle = () =>
  act(async () => {
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0));
  });
function visible(node: FakeNode): string {
  if (node instanceof FakeText) return node.data;
  if (node instanceof FakeElement && node.localName === 'style') return '';
  return node.childNodes.map(visible).join('');
}
const flat = (node: FakeNode) => visible(node).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
const page = (m: Mounted) => flat(m.container);
const buttons = (m: Mounted) => elements(m.container).filter((e) => e.localName === 'button');
const button = (m: Mounted, text: string) => buttons(m).find((b) => flat(b) === text);
const rowStarting = (m: Mounted, text: string) => buttons(m).find((b) => b.className.split(' ').includes('ch-form-row') && flat(b).startsWith(text));
const dialog = (m: Mounted) => elements(m.container).find((e) => e.getAttribute('role') === 'dialog');
const inputOf = (m: Mounted) => elements(dialog(m) as FakeElement).find((e) => e.localName === 'input') as FakeElement;
const formOf = (m: Mounted) => elements(dialog(m) as FakeElement).find((e) => e.localName === 'form') as FakeElement;
const alertsIn = (node: FakeNode) => elements(node).filter((e) => e.getAttribute('role') === 'alert').map(flat);
const statusLine = (m: Mounted) => elements(m.container).filter((e) => e.className === 'ch-notice' && e.getAttribute('role') === 'status').map(flat);
const textOf = (html: string) => html.replace(/<style[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/style>/g, ' ').replace(/<!-- -->/g, '').replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' ').replace(/&#x27;/g, "'").replace(/&quot;/g, '"').replace(/&amp;/g, '&').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();

async function main() {
  SignInMethods = (await import('../app/[locale]/(app)/settings/SignInMethods')).default as unknown as (props: Row) => ReactElement;

  await check('U1 loading (the server\'s render): the section label, a spinner and the loading line, in en, he and ru; no raw key, no emoji', () => {
    for (const l of LOCALES) {
      const html = renderToString(tree(l));
      assert(html.includes(`<h2 class="ch-section-label">${w(l).title}</h2>`), `${l}: the label ${html.slice(0, 200)}`);
      assert(textOf(html).includes(w(l).loading) && /ch-spin/.test(html), `${l}: the loading line`);
      assert(!/settings\./.test(textOf(html)) && !EMOJI.test(html), `${l}: a raw key or an emoji`);
    }
  });

  await check('U2 the rows: Telegram on for a Telegram account; Google\'s address, the calendar account (no address) or Add Google; the email or Add email; nothing to add for a way that isn\'t configured; Sign out only on a web session', async () => {
    for (const l of LOCALES) {
      const t = w(l);
      const fresh = open(l, VIEW());
      await settle();
      try {
        const text = page(fresh.m);
        assert(text.includes(t.telegram) && text.includes(t.on) && text.includes(t.telegramHint), `${l}: Telegram`);
        assert(button(fresh.m, t.googleAdd) && button(fresh.m, t.emailAdd) && button(fresh.m, t.signOutAll) && !button(fresh.m, t.signOut), `${l}: the actions ${show(buttons(fresh.m).map(flat))}`);
      } finally {
        closeAll(fresh);
      }
      const added = open(l, VIEW({ google: { address: ADDRESS }, email: { address: 'd@example.org' }, session: 'google' }));
      await settle();
      try {
        const bdis = elements(added.m.container).filter((e) => e.localName === 'bdi' && e.getAttribute('dir') === 'ltr').map(flat);
        assert(bdis.includes(ADDRESS) && bdis.includes('d@example.org'), `${l}: the addresses ${show(bdis)}`);
        assert(rowStarting(added.m, t.google)?.getAttribute('aria-haspopup') === 'dialog' && rowStarting(added.m, t.email)?.getAttribute('aria-haspopup') === 'dialog', `${l}: the rows open a sheet`);
        assert(!button(added.m, t.googleAdd) && !button(added.m, t.emailAdd) && button(added.m, t.signOut), `${l}: added rows ${show(buttons(added.m).map(flat))}`);
      } finally {
        closeAll(added);
      }
      const calendar = open(l, VIEW({ googleFromCalendar: true }));
      await settle();
      try {
        assert(page(calendar.m).includes(t.googleFromCalendar) && !button(calendar.m, t.googleAdd), `${l}: the calendar's account`);
      } finally {
        closeAll(calendar);
      }
      const noTelegramSignIn = open(l, VIEW({ providers: { telegram: false, google: true, email: true } }));
      await settle();
      try {
        assert(!page(noTelegramSignIn.m).includes(t.telegramHint) && button(noTelegramSignIn.m, t.googleAdd), `${l}: Telegram shows as a way while its sign-in isn't configured: ${page(noTelegramSignIn.m)}`);
      } finally {
        closeAll(noTelegramSignIn);
      }
      const bare = open(l, VIEW({ telegram: false, providers: { telegram: false, google: false, email: false } }));
      await settle();
      try {
        assert(!page(bare.m).includes(t.telegramHint) && !button(bare.m, t.googleAdd) && !button(bare.m, t.emailAdd) && button(bare.m, t.signOutAll), `${l}: nothing configured ${page(bare.m)}`);
      } finally {
        closeAll(bare);
      }
    }
  });

  await check('U3 the read: GET with user_id, same-origin, the initData in the header inside Telegram and none in a browser; a failure says so with Try again, which reads again', async () => {
    calls.length = 0;
    const tg = open('en', VIEW(), { telegram: true });
    await settle();
    try {
      const get = last('/api/signin-methods');
      assert(get && get.url === '/api/signin-methods?user_id=7' && get.method === 'GET' && get.credentials === 'same-origin' && typeof get.headers['X-Telegram-Init-Data'] === 'string', `inside Telegram ${show(get)}`);
    } finally {
      closeAll(tg);
    }
    const web = open('en', VIEW());
    await settle();
    try {
      assert(!('X-Telegram-Init-Data' in (last('/api/signin-methods')?.headers ?? {})), 'a browser sent an initData header');
    } finally {
      closeAll(web);
    }
    appLogs.length = 0;
    const broken = open('he', VIEW());
    routes['GET /api/signin-methods'] = () => json({ error: 'boom' }, 500);
    broken.m.unmount();
    const o = { m: mount(tree('he')) };
    await settle();
    try {
      assert(alertsIn(o.m.container).includes(w('he').loadFailed) && button(o.m, w('he').retry), `he: the failure ${page(o.m)}`);
      assert(appLogs.some((line) => line.includes('GET answered 500')), `logged ${show(appLogs)}`);
      routes['GET /api/signin-methods'] = () => json(VIEW());
      o.m.click(button(o.m, w('he').retry) as FakeElement);
      await settle();
      assert(page(o.m).includes(w('he').telegramHint) && alertsIn(o.m.container).length === 0, 'Try again did not read again');
    } finally {
      closeAll(o);
    }
  });

  await check('U4 Add email: the address with the email keyboard, the code with digits and one-time-code autofill, then the row and the notice; every failure said; a new code for the same address; the sheet waits while a request is out', async () => {
    for (const l of LOCALES) {
      const t = w(l);
      const o = open(l, VIEW(), { telegram: l === 'he' });
      await settle();
      try {
        o.m.click(button(o.m, t.emailAdd) as FakeElement);
        assert(dialog(o.m)?.getAttribute('aria-label') === t.emailSheetTitle, `${l}: the sheet`);
        const field = inputOf(o.m);
        assert(field.getAttribute('type') === 'email' && field.getAttribute('inputmode') === 'email' && field.getAttribute('autocomplete') === 'email' && field.getAttribute('dir') === 'ltr', `${l}: the email field ${show(field.attributes)}`);
        const send = () => button(o.m, t.emailSend) as FakeElement;
        assert(send().hasAttribute('disabled'), `${l}: Send is on with no address`);
        o.m.input(field, ` ${ADDRESS} `);
        for (const [answer, key] of [[() => json({ ok: false, error: 'invalid' }, 400), 'emailInvalid'], [() => json({ ok: false, error: 'limit' }, 429), 'emailLimit'], [() => json({ ok: false, error: 'has-one' }, 409), 'emailHasOne'], [() => json({ error: 'Too many requests. Please wait a minute.' }, 429), 'busy'], [() => Promise.reject(new TypeError('Failed to fetch')), 'failed']] as const) {
          routes['POST /api/signin-methods/email/add'] = answer as () => Response;
          o.m.submit(formOf(o.m));
          await settle();
          assert(alertsIn(dialog(o.m) as FakeElement).includes(t[key]) && inputOf(o.m).getAttribute('type') === 'email', `${l}: ${key}: ${show(alertsIn(dialog(o.m) as FakeElement))}`);
        }
        let release: (r: Response) => void = () => undefined;
        routes['POST /api/signin-methods/email/add'] = () => new Promise<Response>((resolve) => void (release = resolve));
        o.m.submit(formOf(o.m));
        await settle();
        assert(send().hasAttribute('disabled') && page(o.m).includes(t.emailSending), `${l}: no busy state`);
        const closer = sheetCalls.at(-1);
        assert(typeof closer === 'function', `${l}: no closer while busy`);
        await act(async () => closer?.());
        assert(dialog(o.m), `${l}: Back closed the sheet while its request was out`);
        await act(async () => release(json({ ok: true })));
        await settle();
        const added = last('/api/signin-methods/email/add');
        assert(added && added.url === '/api/signin-methods/email/add?user_id=7' && show(added.body) === show({ email: ADDRESS }) && added.headers['Content-Type'] === 'application/json' && added.credentials === 'same-origin', `${l}: the add request ${show(added)}`);
        if (l === 'he') assert(typeof added.headers['X-Telegram-Init-Data'] === 'string' && !('initData' in (added.body ?? {})), `${l}: the initData is not in the header`);
        const code = inputOf(o.m);
        assert(code.getAttribute('inputmode') === 'numeric' && code.getAttribute('autocomplete') === 'one-time-code' && code.getAttribute('maxlength') === '6' && code.getAttribute('dir') === 'ltr', `${l}: the code field ${show(code.attributes)}`);
        const bdi = elements(dialog(o.m) as FakeElement).find((e) => e.localName === 'bdi');
        assert(bdi && flat(bdi) === ADDRESS && bdi.getAttribute('dir') === 'ltr', `${l}: the address in the code step`);
        o.m.input(code, '12 34-56');
        assert(code.value === '123456', `${l}: the code is ${code.value}`);
        for (const [error, key, status] of [['wrong', 'codeWrong', 400], ['taken', 'codeTaken', 409], ['has-one', 'emailHasOne', 409], ['limit', 'codeLimit', 429]] as const) {
          routes['POST /api/signin-methods/email/confirm'] = () => json({ ok: false, error }, status);
          o.m.submit(formOf(o.m));
          await settle();
          assert(alertsIn(dialog(o.m) as FakeElement).includes(t[key]) && inputOf(o.m).getAttribute('inputmode') === 'numeric', `${l}: ${error}`);
        }
        const before = calls.length;
        routes['POST /api/signin-methods/email/add'] = () => json({ ok: true });
        o.m.click(button(o.m, t.codeAgain) as FakeElement);
        await settle();
        assert(calls.length > before && last('/api/signin-methods/email/add')?.url === '/api/signin-methods/email/add?user_id=7' && show(last('/api/signin-methods/email/add')?.body) === show({ email: ADDRESS }), `${l}: a new code`);
        o.m.input(inputOf(o.m), '123456');
        routes['POST /api/signin-methods/email/confirm'] = () => json({ ok: false, error: 'restart' }, 400);
        o.m.submit(formOf(o.m));
        await settle();
        assert(inputOf(o.m).getAttribute('type') === 'email' && inputOf(o.m).value === ADDRESS && alertsIn(dialog(o.m) as FakeElement).includes(t.codeRestart), `${l}: restart`);
        o.m.submit(formOf(o.m));
        await settle();
        o.m.input(inputOf(o.m), '123456');
        routes['POST /api/signin-methods/email/confirm'] = () => json({ ok: true, methods: methodsOf(VIEW({ email: { address: ADDRESS } })) });
        o.m.submit(formOf(o.m));
        await settle();
        assert(last('/api/signin-methods/email/confirm')?.url === '/api/signin-methods/email/confirm?user_id=7' && show(last('/api/signin-methods/email/confirm')?.body) === show({ code: '123456' }), `${l}: the confirm request ${show(last('/api/signin-methods/email/confirm'))}`);
        assert(!dialog(o.m) && rowStarting(o.m, t.email) && !button(o.m, t.emailAdd), `${l}: the row after adding`);
        assert(statusLine(o.m).includes(say(l, 'added', { kind: 'email' })), `${l}: the notice ${show(statusLine(o.m))}`);
      } finally {
        closeAll(o);
      }
    }
  });

  await check('U5 Remove asks first: Google\'s (google), the calendar account\'s (calendar-google) and the email\'s (email), each with its words; the rows after and the notice; a failure keeps the sheet with the reason', async () => {
    for (const l of LOCALES) {
      const t = w(l);
      for (const [view, which, kind, body] of [
        [VIEW({ google: { address: ADDRESS } }), 'google', 'google', 'removeBody'],
        [VIEW({ googleFromCalendar: true }), 'calendar-google', 'google', 'removeCalendarBody'],
        [VIEW({ email: { address: ADDRESS } }), 'email', 'email', 'removeBody'],
      ] as const) {
        const o = open(l, view);
        await settle();
        try {
          o.m.click(rowStarting(o.m, kind === 'google' ? t.google : t.email) as FakeElement);
          const d = dialog(o.m) as FakeElement;
          assert(d && d.getAttribute('aria-label') === say(l, 'removeTitle', { kind }) && flat(d).includes(t[body]), `${l} ${which}: the sheet ${d && flat(d)}`);
          if (which !== 'calendar-google') assert(flat(d).includes(ADDRESS), `${l} ${which}: no address in the sheet`);
          routes['POST /api/signin-methods/remove'] = () => json({ error: 'boom' }, 500);
          o.m.click(button(o.m, t.remove) as FakeElement);
          await settle();
          assert(dialog(o.m) && alertsIn(dialog(o.m) as FakeElement).includes(t.failed), `${l} ${which}: the failure`);
          routes['POST /api/signin-methods/remove'] = () => json({ ok: true, methods: methodsOf(VIEW()) });
          o.m.click(button(o.m, t.remove) as FakeElement);
          await settle();
          assert(last('/api/signin-methods/remove')?.url === '/api/signin-methods/remove?user_id=7' && show(last('/api/signin-methods/remove')?.body) === show({ which }), `${l} ${which}: the request ${show(last('/api/signin-methods/remove'))}`);
          assert(!dialog(o.m) && button(o.m, kind === 'google' ? t.googleAdd : t.emailAdd) && statusLine(o.m).includes(t.removed), `${l} ${which}: after`);
        } finally {
          closeAll(o);
        }
      }
    }
  });

  await check('U6 Add Google: inside Telegram a sheet opens the one-time link in the browser on the tap (openLink, absolute); in a browser this tab goes there; a failure says so', async () => {
    const tg = open('he', VIEW(), { telegram: true });
    await settle();
    try {
      // Task 6 answers the link absolute (buildUrl over localeHref, ?token=)
      routes['POST /api/auth/google/add-link'] = () => json({ url: `https://famcal.bot/he/signin/add-google?token=${LINK_TOKEN}` });
      tg.m.click(button(tg.m, w('he').googleAdd) as FakeElement);
      await settle();
      assert(last('/api/auth/google/add-link')?.url === '/api/auth/google/add-link?user_id=7' && show(last('/api/auth/google/add-link')?.body) === show({}), `the add-link request ${show(last('/api/auth/google/add-link'))}`);
      assert(dialog(tg.m)?.getAttribute('aria-label') === w('he').googleSheetTitle && flat(dialog(tg.m) as FakeElement).includes(w('he').googleSheetBody), 'no sheet inside Telegram');
      assert(!tg.tgCalls.some((c) => c.startsWith('openLink')), 'the link opened before the tap');
      tg.m.click(button(tg.m, w('he').googleOpen) as FakeElement);
      assert(tg.tgCalls.includes(`openLink(https://famcal.bot/he/signin/add-google?token=${LINK_TOKEN})`), `openLink ${show(tg.tgCalls)}`);
      assert(!dialog(tg.m) && statusLine(tg.m).includes(w('he').googleOpened), 'after the tap');
    } finally {
      closeAll(tg);
    }
    const web = open('en', VIEW());
    await settle();
    try {
      // A site-relative link resolves against the page's origin too
      routes['POST /api/auth/google/add-link'] = () => json({ url: `/signin/add-google?token=${LINK_TOKEN}` });
      web.m.click(button(web.m, w('en').googleAdd) as FakeElement);
      await settle();
      assert(show(assigned) === show([`https://famcal.bot/signin/add-google?token=${LINK_TOKEN}`]) && !dialog(web.m), `a browser ${show(assigned)}`);
    } finally {
      closeAll(web);
    }
    const bad = open('ru', VIEW());
    await settle();
    try {
      routes['POST /api/auth/google/add-link'] = () => json({ error: 'boom' }, 500);
      bad.m.click(button(bad.m, w('ru').googleAdd) as FakeElement);
      await settle();
      assert(alertsIn(bad.m.container).includes(w('ru').failed) && !dialog(bad.m) && !(button(bad.m, w('ru').googleAdd) as FakeElement).hasAttribute('disabled'), 'a failure');
    } finally {
      closeAll(bad);
    }
  });

  await check('U7 Sign out: on a web session the route, then /signin in the page\'s language; Sign out on all devices: the route with user_id, then /signin (web) or the notice (the Mini App); a failure says so', async () => {
    for (const l of LOCALES) {
      const signin = l === 'en' ? '/signin' : `/${l}/signin`;
      const web = open(l, VIEW({ session: 'email' }));
      await settle();
      try {
        routes['POST /api/auth/signout'] = () => json({ ok: true });
        web.m.click(button(web.m, w(l).signOut) as FakeElement);
        await settle();
        assert(last('/api/auth/signout') && show(assigned) === show([signin]), `${l}: sign out ${show(assigned)}`);
      } finally {
        closeAll(web);
      }
      const webAll = open(l, VIEW({ session: 'google' }));
      await settle();
      try {
        routes['POST /api/auth/signout-all'] = () => json({ ok: true });
        webAll.m.click(button(webAll.m, w(l).signOutAll) as FakeElement);
        await settle();
        assert(last('/api/auth/signout-all')?.url === '/api/auth/signout-all?user_id=7' && show(last('/api/auth/signout-all')?.body) === show({}) && show(assigned) === show([signin]), `${l}: all, on the web`);
      } finally {
        closeAll(webAll);
      }
      const mini = open(l, VIEW(), { telegram: true });
      await settle();
      try {
        routes['POST /api/auth/signout-all'] = () => json({}, 500);
        mini.m.click(button(mini.m, w(l).signOutAll) as FakeElement);
        await settle();
        assert(alertsIn(mini.m.container).includes(w(l).failed), `${l}: a failure`);
        routes['POST /api/auth/signout-all'] = () => json({ ok: true });
        mini.m.click(button(mini.m, w(l).signOutAll) as FakeElement);
        await settle();
        assert(assigned.length === 0 && statusLine(mini.m).includes(w(l).signedOutAll), `${l}: all, in the Mini App ${show(statusLine(mini.m))}`);
      } finally {
        closeAll(mini);
      }
    }
  });

  await check('U8 Back: while a sheet is open the screen holds a closer that closes it; once closed, null', async () => {
    const o = open('en', VIEW({ google: { address: ADDRESS } }));
    await settle();
    try {
      assert(sheetCalls.at(-1) === null, `closed at first: ${show(sheetCalls.map((c) => typeof c))}`);
      o.m.click(rowStarting(o.m, w('en').google) as FakeElement);
      const closer = sheetCalls.at(-1);
      assert(typeof closer === 'function' && dialog(o.m), 'no closer while the sheet is open');
      await act(async () => closer?.());
      assert(!dialog(o.m) && sheetCalls.at(-1) === null, 'the closer did not close it');
    } finally {
      closeAll(o);
    }
  });

  await check('U9 no log line holds an address, a code or the link\'s token', () => {
    const leaked = appLogs.filter((line) => line.includes(ADDRESS) || /\b123456\b/.test(line) || line.includes(LINK_TOKEN));
    assert(appLogs.length > 0 && leaked.length === 0, `${appLogs.length} lines, leaked ${show(leaked)}`);
  });

  await check('U10 the words: every key the group reads is in en, he and ru; none is left unread; the group writes no copy of its own', () => {
    const file = 'app/[locale]/(app)/settings/SignInMethods.tsx';
    const src = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, file), 'utf8');
    const keys = Object.keys(w('en')).sort();
    for (const l of LOCALES) assert(show(Object.keys(w(l)).sort()) === show(keys), `${l}: other keys than en`);
    for (const l of LOCALES) for (const k of keys) assert(typeof w(l)[k] === 'string' && w(l)[k].trim() !== '', `${l}: ${k} is empty`);
    const read = [...src.matchAll(/\bt(?:\.rich)?\('([\w.]+)'/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
    assert(read.length > 20, `only ${read.length} reads found`);
    for (const k of read) assert(keys.includes(k), `${k} is read but is not a message`);
    const unread = keys.filter((k) => !src.includes(`'${k}'`));
    assert(unread.length === 0, `keys nothing reads: ${show(unread)}`);
    assert(show(jsxCopy(file, src)) === '[]', `copy in the TSX: ${show(jsxCopy(file, src))}`);
  });

  await check('U11 TextField: the email and code kinds read left to right with their keyboard and autofill; the default field is exactly what it was', () => {
    const Field = TextField as unknown as (p: Row) => ReactElement;
    const html = (p: Row) => renderToString(createElement(Field, { label: 'Notes', value: 'Bring the form', onChange: () => undefined, placeholder: 'Add notes', ...p }));
    assert(html({}) === '<input class="ch-form-field" aria-label="Notes" placeholder="Add notes" dir="auto" type="text" enterKeyHint="done" autoComplete="off" value="Bring the form"/>', `the default ${html({})}`);

    const code = html({ kind: 'code', maxLength: 6 });

  });

  await check('U12 React logged no warning', () => {

  });

  let failed = 0;
  for (const r of results) {

    if (!r.ok) failed++;
```

```ts
// Settings' side of the sign-in ways (spec 2026-11-02-web-sign-in §4): the "Sign in on the web" group's requests. Each one
// sends JSON with credentials: 'same-origin' (the session cookie in a browser; a POST carries the page's Origin, which
// the routes require), the account in the query string as every user route of the app reads it (?user_id=, the id is not
// a secret) and the initData in the X-Telegram-Init-Data header inside Telegram (initDataHeaders), never in a URL or a
// body. Every answer comes back as a result the group words (settings.signIn.*), and every failure is logged with the
// route (without its query) and the status only: never an address, a code or a link.

import type { SignInMethod } from '@/src/lib/session-auth';
import { initDataHeaders } from '@/src/lib/read-init-data';
import { readJsonBody } from '@/src/lib/read-json';
import type { SignInMethodsView } from '@/src/services/web-signin/identities';

export type MethodsView = SignInMethodsView & { session: SignInMethod | null };
export type RemoveWhich = 'google' | 'email' | 'calendar-google';
export type RequestError = 'failed' | 'busy';
export type AddEmailError = RequestError | 'invalid' | 'limit' | 'has-one';
/** 'codeLimit' is the confirm route's `limit` (too many wrong codes): Add's own `limit` is the day's codes. */
export type ConfirmEmailError = RequestError | 'wrong' | 'taken' | 'restart' | 'codeLimit' | 'has-one';

const TAG = '[signin-methods]';
const SESSION_METHODS: readonly string[] = ['tg', 'google', 'email', 'wa'];

const isAddress = (value: unknown) => value === null || (typeof value === 'object' && typeof (value as { address?: unknown }).address === 'string');

/** The shape GET /api/signin-methods answers, and the `methods` of the confirm and remove answers. */
export function isMethodsView(value: unknown): value is SignInMethodsView {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return false;
  const v = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  const p = v.providers as Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined;
  return typeof v.telegram === 'boolean' && typeof v.googleFromCalendar === 'boolean' && isAddress(v.google) && isAddress(v.email) && !!p && typeof p.telegram === 'boolean' && typeof p.google === 'boolean' && typeof p.email === 'boolean';
}

/** A 429 is the route's rate limit; anything else is a plain failure. */
const statusError = (status: number): RequestError => (status === 429 ? 'busy' : 'failed');

/** One POST for an account (`?user_id=`; null for the one route that needs only the cookie): its status and body, or null when it never got an answer (logged). */
async function post(pathname: string, userId: number | null, body: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<{ status: number; ok: boolean; body: Record<string, unknown> | null } | null> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(userId === null ? pathname : `${pathname}?user_id=${userId}`, {
      method: 'POST',
      credentials: 'same-origin',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...initDataHeaders() },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    });
    const answer = await readJsonBody(res, `${TAG} ${pathname}`);
    if (!res.ok) console.warn(`${TAG} ${pathname} answered ${res.status}`);
    return { status: res.status, ok: res.ok, body: answer };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`${TAG} ${pathname} failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.name : typeof error}`);
    return null;
  }
}

export async function loadMethods(userId: number): Promise<{ kind: 'ok'; view: MethodsView } | { kind: 'error' }> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/signin-methods?user_id=${userId}`, { credentials: 'same-origin', headers: initDataHeaders() });
    const body = await readJsonBody(res, `${TAG} GET`);
    if (res.ok && isMethodsView(body)) {
      const session = (body as { session?: unknown }).session;
      return { kind: 'ok', view: { ...body, session: typeof session === 'string' && SESSION_METHODS.includes(session) ? (session as SignInMethod) : null } };
    }
    console.warn(`${TAG} GET answered ${res.status}`);
    return { kind: 'error' };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`${TAG} GET failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.name : typeof error}`);
    return { kind: 'error' };
  }
}

export async function addEmail(userId: number, email: string): Promise<{ kind: 'ok' } | { kind: 'error'; code: AddEmailError }> {
  const r = await post('/api/signin-methods/email/add', userId, { email });
  if (!r) return { kind: 'error', code: 'failed' };
  if (r.ok && r.body?.ok === true) return { kind: 'ok' };
  if (r.body?.error === 'invalid') return { kind: 'error', code: 'invalid' };
  if (r.body?.error === 'limit') return { kind: 'error', code: 'limit' };
  if (r.body?.error === 'has-one') return { kind: 'error', code: 'has-one' };
  return { kind: 'error', code: statusError(r.status) };
}

export async function confirmEmail(userId: number, code: string): Promise<{ kind: 'ok'; methods: SignInMethodsView } | { kind: 'error'; code: ConfirmEmailError }> {
  const r = await post('/api/signin-methods/email/confirm', userId, { code });
  if (!r) return { kind: 'error', code: 'failed' };
  if (r.ok && r.body?.ok === true && isMethodsView(r.body.methods)) return { kind: 'ok', methods: r.body.methods };
  const error = r.body?.error;
  if (error === 'wrong' || error === 'taken' || error === 'restart' || error === 'has-one') return { kind: 'error', code: error };
  if (error === 'limit') return { kind: 'error', code: 'codeLimit' };
  return { kind: 'error', code: statusError(r.status) };
}

export async function removeMethod(userId: number, which: RemoveWhich): Promise<{ kind: 'ok'; methods: SignInMethodsView } | { kind: 'error'; code: RequestError }> {
  const r = await post('/api/signin-methods/remove', userId, { which });
  if (r?.ok && r.body?.ok === true && isMethodsView(r.body.methods)) return { kind: 'ok', methods: r.body.methods };
  return { kind: 'error', code: r ? statusError(r.status) : 'failed' };
}

export async function requestGoogleLink(userId: number): Promise<{ kind: 'ok'; url: string } | { kind: 'error'; code: RequestError }> {
  const r = await post('/api/auth/google/add-link', userId, {});
  if (r?.ok && typeof r.body?.url === 'string') return { kind: 'ok', url: r.body.url };
  return { kind: 'error', code: r ? statusError(r.status) : 'failed' };
}

export async function signOutHere(): Promise<{ kind: 'ok' } | { kind: 'error'; code: RequestError }> {
  const r = await post('/api/auth/signout', null, {});
  return r?.ok && r.body?.ok === true ? { kind: 'ok' } : { kind: 'error', code: r ? statusError(r.status) : 'failed' };
}

export async function signOutAll(userId: number): Promise<{ kind: 'ok' } | { kind: 'error'; code: RequestError }> {
  const r = await post('/api/auth/signout-all', userId, {});
  return r?.ok && r.body?.ok === true ? { kind: 'ok' } : { kind: 'error', code: r ? statusError(r.status) : 'failed' };
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

// Settings' "Sign in on the web" group (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-02-web-sign-in-design.md §4, §2.9, §2.13,
// §2.17), in the Mini App and in the web app. It reads its own rows (GET /api/signin-methods) and saves each change by
// itself: it is not part of the Save bar.
//
// - Telegram shows as on for a Telegram account, only while Telegram sign-in is configured (view.providers.telegram): a
//   row that says "on" for a way /signin doesn't offer would mislead. Telegram and WhatsApp can't be removed here.
// - Google: Add asks for a one-time link (POST /api/auth/google/add-link, 5 minutes) to famcal.bot's add-Google page.
//   Google refuses in-app browsers, so inside Telegram a sheet opens it in the browser with Telegram's openLink on the tap
//   itself (a link opened after an await may be refused, as on the Calendars screen); in a browser this tab goes there.
//   Once added, the row is the address. Before its first use, the Google account the calendar is connected from shows
//   as on, with no address (FamCal keeps none). Removing either asks first ('google' or 'calendar-google').
// - Email: Add asks for the address, mails a code, then asks for the code; an address on another account is refused
//   only after its code is right ('taken'). Remove asks first.
// - Every removal signs out the other browsers (the server moves sessionsValidAfter; this device keeps a fresh cookie).
// - Sign out (only on a web session: there is a cookie to clear) goes to /signin; Sign out on all devices goes there too
//   on the web, and says it is done in the Mini App.
// - The requests are signin-methods-client.ts; each failure is said here in words and logged there with its status.
// - `onSheet` tells the screen what Back should do while a sheet is open (its closer, a no-op while its request is out),
//   and null once it is closed, as GoogleDisconnect does.
//
// Strings: settings.signIn.*. Lucide icons only.

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { useLocale, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { BottomSheet } from '@/components/app-ui/BottomSheet';
import { ButtonRow, FormCard, FormRow, TextField } from '@/components/app-ui/form-kit';
import { Notice } from '@/components/app-ui/Notice';
import { SectionLabel } from '@/components/app-ui/ScreenHeader';
import { isInTelegram, openExternalLink } from '@/src/lib/telegram-ui';
import type { SignInMethodsView } from '@/src/services/web-signin/identities';
import { signInHref } from '@/src/site/signin';
import { addEmail, confirmEmail, loadMethods, removeMethod, requestGoogleLink, signOutAll, signOutHere, type AddEmailError, type ConfirmEmailError, type MethodsView, type RemoveWhich, type RequestError } from './signin-methods-client';

type Phase = { kind: 'loading' } | { kind: 'error' } | { kind: 'ready'; view: MethodsView };
type EmailError = AddEmailError | ConfirmEmailError;
type EmailSheet = { kind: 'email'; step: 'address' | 'code'; address: string; code: string; error: EmailError | null; busy: boolean };
type RemoveSheet = { kind: 'remove'; which: RemoveWhich; address: string | null; error: RequestError | null; busy: boolean };
type GoogleSheet = { kind: 'google'; url: string };
type Sheet = EmailSheet | RemoveSheet | GoogleSheet;
type Working = 'google' | 'signOut' | 'signOutAll';
type Status = { tone: 'info' | 'error'; text: string };

/** Each failure's words: a key of settings.signIn. */
const ERROR_KEY: Record<EmailError, string> = {
  failed: 'failed',
  busy: 'busy',
  invalid: 'emailInvalid',
  limit: 'emailLimit',
  'has-one': 'emailHasOne',
  wrong: 'codeWrong',
  taken: 'codeTaken',
  restart: 'codeRestart',
  codeLimit: 'codeLimit',
};

const noop = () => {};

export default function SignInMethods({ userId, onSheet }: { userId: number; onSheet?: (close: (() => void) | null) => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations('settings.signIn');
  const locale = useLocale();
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>({ kind: 'loading' });
  const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0);
  const [sheet, setSheet] = useState<Sheet | null>(null);
  const [working, setWorking] = useState<Working | null>(null);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    void loadMethods(userId).then((result) => {
      if (live) setPhase(result.kind === 'ok' ? { kind: 'ready', view: result.view } : { kind: 'error' });
    });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [userId, attempt]);

  // The closers run later than the render that made them: they read the screen's latest callback
  const latest = useRef(onSheet);
  useEffect(() => {
    latest.current = onSheet;
  });
  const sheetOpen = sheet !== null;
  const sheetBusy = sheet !== null && sheet.kind !== 'google' && sheet.busy;
  useEffect(() => {
    latest.current?.(!sheetOpen ? null : sheetBusy ? noop : () => setSheet(null));
  }, [sheetOpen, sheetBusy]);
  useEffect(() => () => latest.current?.(null), []);

  const view = phase.kind === 'ready' ? phase.view : null;
  /** New rows from a change: the session this page was opened with stays (a removal gives this device a fresh cookie of the same kind). */
  const showMethods = (methods: SignInMethodsView) => setPhase((p) => ({ kind: 'ready', view: { ...methods, session: p.kind === 'ready' ? p.view.session : null } }));
  const editEmail = (patch: Partial<EmailSheet>) => setSheet((s) => (s && s.kind === 'email' ? { ...s, ...patch } : s));
  const retry = () => {
    setPhase({ kind: 'loading' });
    setAttempt((n) => n + 1);
  };

  const addGoogle = async () => {
    if (working) return;
    setWorking('google');
    setStatus(null);
    const result = await requestGoogleLink(userId);
    setWorking(null);
    if (result.kind === 'error') {
      setStatus({ tone: 'error', text: t(ERROR_KEY[result.code]) });
      return;
    }
    const url = new URL(result.url, window.location.origin).href;
    if (isInTelegram()) setSheet({ kind: 'google', url });
    else window.location.assign(url);
  };

  const openGoogle = (url: string) => {
    setSheet(null);
    if (openExternalLink(url)) {
      setStatus({ tone: 'info', text: t('googleOpened') });
      return;
    }
    console.warn('[signin-methods] the browser could not be opened for Add Google');
    setStatus({ tone: 'error', text: t('failed') });
  };

  const sendCode = async (address: string, from: EmailSheet['step']) => {
    setSheet({ kind: 'email', step: from, address, code: '', error: null, busy: true });
    const result = await addEmail(userId, address);
    if (result.kind === 'ok') setSheet({ kind: 'email', step: 'code', address, code: '', error: null, busy: false });
    else setSheet({ kind: 'email', step: 'address', address, code: '', error: result.code, busy: false });
  };

  const checkCode = async (address: string, code: string) => {
    setSheet({ kind: 'email', step: 'code', address, code, error: null, busy: true });
    const result = await confirmEmail(userId, code);
    if (result.kind === 'ok') {
      setSheet(null);
      showMethods(result.methods);
      setStatus({ tone: 'info', text: t('added', { kind: 'email' }) });
      return;
    }
    if (result.code === 'restart') {
      setSheet({ kind: 'email', step: 'address', address, code: '', error: 'restart', busy: false });
      return;
    }
    setSheet({ kind: 'email', step: 'code', address, code, error: result.code, busy: false });
  };

  const remove = async (which: RemoveWhich, address: string | null) => {
    setSheet({ kind: 'remove', which, address, error: null, busy: true });
    const result = await removeMethod(userId, which);
    if (result.kind === 'ok') {
      setSheet(null);
      showMethods(result.methods);
      setStatus({ tone: 'info', text: t('removed') });
      return;
    }
    setSheet({ kind: 'remove', which, address, error: result.code, busy: false });
  };

  const signOut = async () => {
    if (working) return;
    setWorking('signOut');
    setStatus(null);
    const result = await signOutHere();
    if (result.kind === 'ok') {
      window.location.assign(signInHref(locale));
      return;
    }
    setWorking(null);
    setStatus({ tone: 'error', text: t(ERROR_KEY[result.code]) });
  };

  const signOutEverywhere = async () => {
    if (working || !view) return;
    setWorking('signOutAll');
    setStatus(null);
    const result = await signOutAll(userId);
    if (result.kind === 'ok' && view.session) {
      window.location.assign(signInHref(locale));
      return;
    }
    setWorking(null);
    setStatus(result.kind === 'ok' ? { tone: 'info', text: t('signedOutAll') } : { tone: 'error', text: t(ERROR_KEY[result.code]) });
  };

  const openRemove = (which: RemoveWhich, address: string | null) => {
    setStatus(null);
    setSheet({ kind: 'remove', which, address, error: null, busy: false });
  };
  const openEmail = () => {
    setStatus(null);
    setSheet({ kind: 'email', step: 'address', address: '', code: '', error: null, busy: false });
  };

  const spin = <Loader2 size={16} className="ch-spin" aria-hidden="true" />;
  const workingLine = (text: string) => (
    <p className="ch-form-fixed ch-working">
      {spin} {text}
    </p>
  );
  const off = working !== null;

  return (
    <>
      <SectionLabel>{t('title')}</SectionLabel>
      {phase.kind === 'loading' ? (
        <FormCard>
          <div className="ch-form-row">
            <p className="ch-form-fixed ch-working" role="status">
              {spin} {t('loading')}
            </p>
          </div>
        </FormCard>
      ) : phase.kind === 'error' || !view ? (
        <Notice tone="error" action={{ label: t('retry'), onClick: retry }}>
          {t('loadFailed')}
        </Notice>
      ) : (
        <>
          <FormCard>
            <div className="ch-form-row">
              <span className="ch-form-hint">{t('hint')}</span>
            </div>
            {view.telegram && view.providers.telegram ? (
              <FormRow label={t('telegram')} hint={t('telegramHint')}>
                <span className="ch-form-value">
                  <span className="ch-form-value-text">{t('on')}</span>
                </span>
              </FormRow>
            ) : null}
            {view.google ? (
              <ButtonRow label={t('google')} value={view.google.address} valueDir="ltr" disabled={off} onClick={() => openRemove('google', view.google?.address ?? null)} />
            ) : view.googleFromCalendar && view.providers.google ? (
              <ButtonRow label={t('google')} hint={t('googleFromCalendar')} value={t('on')} disabled={off} onClick={() => openRemove('calendar-google', null)} />
            ) : view.providers.google ? (
              <button type="button" className="ch-form-row ch-action-row" disabled={off} aria-busy={working === 'google' || undefined} onClick={() => void addGoogle()}>
                {working === 'google' ? (
                  <>
                    {spin} {t('googlePreparing')}
                  </>
                ) : (
                  t('googleAdd')
                )}
              </button>
            ) : null}
            {view.email ? (
              <ButtonRow label={t('email')} value={view.email.address} valueDir="ltr" disabled={off} onClick={() => openRemove('email', view.email?.address ?? null)} />
            ) : view.providers.email ? (
              <button type="button" className="ch-form-row ch-action-row" disabled={off} onClick={openEmail}>
                {t('emailAdd')}
              </button>
            ) : null}
          </FormCard>
          <FormCard>
            {view.session ? (
              <button type="button" className="ch-form-row ch-action-row" disabled={off} aria-busy={working === 'signOut' || undefined} onClick={() => void signOut()}>
                {working === 'signOut' ? (
                  <>
                    {spin} {t('signingOut')}
                  </>
                ) : (
                  t('signOut')
                )}
              </button>
            ) : null}
            <button type="button" className="ch-form-row ch-action-row" disabled={off} aria-busy={working === 'signOutAll' || undefined} onClick={() => void signOutEverywhere()}>
              {working === 'signOutAll' ? (
                <>
                  {spin} {t('signingOut')}
                </>
              ) : (
                t('signOutAll')
              )}
            </button>
          </FormCard>
        </>
      )}
      {status ? <Notice tone={status.tone}>{status.text}</Notice> : null}

      {sheet?.kind === 'remove' ? (
        <BottomSheet label={t('removeTitle', { kind: sheet.which === 'email' ? 'email' : 'google' })} closeLabel={t('cancel')} closeDisabled={sheet.busy} onClose={() => setSheet(null)}>
          <h2 className="ch-sheet-heading">{t('removeTitle', { kind: sheet.which === 'email' ? 'email' : 'google' })}</h2>
          {sheet.address ? (
            <p className="ch-sheet-sub">
              <bdi dir="ltr">{sheet.address}</bdi>
            </p>
          ) : null}
          <p className="ch-sheet-sub">{sheet.which === 'calendar-google' ? t('removeCalendarBody') : t('removeBody')}</p>
          <div className="ch-sheet-stack">
            {sheet.error ? <Notice tone="error">{t(ERROR_KEY[sheet.error])}</Notice> : null}
            {sheet.busy ? workingLine(t('removing')) : null}
            <button type="button" className="ch-btn ch-btn-primary ch-btn-danger ch-save" disabled={sheet.busy} onClick={() => void remove(sheet.which, sheet.address)}>
              {t('remove')}
            </button>
          </div>
        </BottomSheet>
      ) : null}

      {sheet?.kind === 'google' ? (
        <BottomSheet label={t('googleSheetTitle')} closeLabel={t('cancel')} onClose={() => setSheet(null)}>
          <h2 className="ch-sheet-heading">{t('googleSheetTitle')}</h2>
          <p className="ch-sheet-sub">{t('googleSheetBody')}</p>
          <div className="ch-sheet-stack">
            <button type="button" className="ch-btn ch-btn-primary ch-save" onClick={() => openGoogle(sheet.url)}>
              {t('googleOpen')}
            </button>
          </div>
        </BottomSheet>
      ) : null}

      {sheet?.kind === 'email' ? (
        <BottomSheet label={t('emailSheetTitle')} closeLabel={t('cancel')} closeDisabled={sheet.busy} onClose={() => setSheet(null)}>
          <h2 className="ch-sheet-heading">{t('emailSheetTitle')}</h2>
          {sheet.step === 'address' ? (
            <form
              onSubmit={(event: FormEvent) => {
                event.preventDefault();
                const address = sheet.address.trim();
                if (!sheet.busy && address !== '') void sendCode(address, 'address');
              }}
              noValidate
            >
              <p className="ch-sheet-sub">{t('emailBody')}</p>
              <div className="ch-sheet-stack">
                <FormCard>
                  <TextField kind="email" label={t('emailLabel')} placeholder={t('emailLabel')} value={sheet.address} disabled={sheet.busy} error={sheet.error ? t(ERROR_KEY[sheet.error]) : null} onChange={(address) => editEmail({ address, error: null })} />
                </FormCard>
                {sheet.busy ? workingLine(t('emailSending')) : null}
                <button type="submit" className="ch-btn ch-btn-primary ch-save" disabled={sheet.busy || sheet.address.trim() === ''}>
                  {t('emailSend')}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          ) : (
            <form
              onSubmit={(event: FormEvent) => {
                event.preventDefault();
                if (!sheet.busy && sheet.code.length === 6) void checkCode(sheet.address, sheet.code);
              }}
              noValidate
            >
              <p className="ch-sheet-sub">{t.rich('codeBody', { address: sheet.address, addr: (chunks) => <bdi dir="ltr">{chunks}</bdi> })}</p>
              <div className="ch-sheet-stack">
                <FormCard>
                  <TextField kind="code" label={t('codeLabel')} placeholder={t('codeLabel')} value={sheet.code} maxLength={6} disabled={sheet.busy} error={sheet.error ? t(ERROR_KEY[sheet.error]) : null} onChange={(code) => editEmail({ code: code.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 6), error: null })} />
                </FormCard>
                {sheet.busy ? workingLine(t('codeChecking')) : null}
                <button type="submit" className="ch-btn ch-btn-primary ch-save" disabled={sheet.busy || sheet.code.length !== 6}>
                  {t('codeConfirm')}
                </button>
                <button type="button" className="ch-btn" disabled={sheet.busy} onClick={() => void sendCode(sheet.address, 'code')}>
                  {t('codeAgain')}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          )}
        </BottomSheet>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}
```

(The `maxLength={6}` on the code field stops typing at six; the `onChange` also strips anything that isn't a digit,
so a pasted "12 34-56" becomes 123456.)

## Part G: the fixes the web makes visible (Task 10)

Spec §2.14. One task, five small fixes, one commit. Every code block below was applied to a scratch copy of `main` at 2b38fc4c (`git archive`, nothing in the repo was touched) and checked there: `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run lint` clean, the new smoke and every smoke it touches green, the whole `bash scripts/ci-smokes.sh` at 170 of 172 (the 2 that fail, `smoke-site-pages` P2 and P5 and `smoke-site-seo` S1, fail the same way on an untouched copy of `main` made with a symlinked `node_modules`, so they are the scratch copy, not this task). The new and changed checks were also run against the untouched sources and fail there (step 3). Task 2's session fields did not exist in the scratch copy, so a stand-in for them was used there only; the code below is written to the contract.

### Contract notes (corrections against the real code; names stay consistent)

1. **There is one no-access card, not two.** `CalendarHome`'s 401 card is not its own copy: it renders `PageGate`'s `NoCredentialCard` with `CLIENT_GATE_LINKS` (`CalendarHome.tsx:1054-1056`). `TelegramDashboardRedirect` renders it too. One change to `NoCredentialCard` gives Sign in to all three. `CLIENT_GATE_LINKS` stays (WhatsApp and bot links only; the Sign in link needs just the locale, which the card reads with `useLocale()`).
2. **The sign-in link is a plain anchor to `signInHref(locale)`**, the one builder of the /signin path, which Task 2 (part A) creates in `src/site/signin.ts` and Task 8 (part F) extends. This task adds no builder of its own (no `src/lib/signin-link.ts`). It answers `/signin` for en, `/he/signin` and `/ru/signin`, and an unknown locale gets `/signin` (the site's routing is `localePrefix: 'as-needed'`, `i18n/routing.ts`). The contract's `/{lang}/signin` would add a redirect hop for English. A plain `<a>` because the app and the site are two root layouts (full page load either way). `src/site/signin.ts` imports no server module (its value imports are `localeHref` and `normalizeLocale`, both client-safe; `SignInStatus` is `import type` from `src/lib/web-session.ts`), so the client card may import it.
3. **`StateCard` gains a `tertiary` action.** The browser card now has three buttons (Sign in filled, then WhatsApp, then the bot); the card took two. Additive: no existing card changes.
4. **`resolveCommandTarget` keeps returning `CommandTarget | null`** (`smoke-auth-identity` #11 pins that), and gains an optional third argument, the session's `SignInMethod`. The reason the contract asks for comes from a new `resolveCommandTargetOrReason` (`{ ok: true, target } | { ok: false, reason: 'wa_link_needed' | 'no_channel' }`), which the route uses. A `session` with no method counts as `'wa'`, so every cookie from before web sign-in behaves as it did.
5. **Depends on Task 2:** `verifyUserAuth`'s success value for a session carries `session: WebSession` (contract), and the route reads `auth.session.method`; the new smoke checks mint cookies with `createSessionToken(userId, method, Date.now())` and `SESSION_COOKIE_NAME` (contract). If Task 2 names differ, only `sessionCookie()` in step 2 and the one route line change.
6. **The route answers `platform: 'telegram' | 'whatsapp'`** (the `MessagingPlatform` values) in its success body, and `error: 'wa_link_needed'` (HTTP 400) next to the old `'no_channel'`. The client's `SendResult` gains `chat: 'unknown'` (a 2xx that names no chat, which only a broken server gives: logged, and the sheet says the plain "Sent. Check your chat", which stays as `send.sent`) and `reason?: 'wa_link_needed'` on `failed`.
7. **"Hidden" is `document.visibilityState === 'hidden'`** (what `document.hidden` reports, and what `CalendarHome` already checks), read through a small pure helper, `src/lib/visibility-timers.ts` (new), so the poll logic is tested without a browser. The helper's rule: a tick that finds the tab hidden does not run and sets no further timer; the poll takes up again one full interval after the tab shows. That is deliberate: the Calendars screen's own `visibilitychange` handler (`CalendarsClient.tsx:253-258`) already refreshes at once on show, so resuming with an immediate poll would ask twice.
8. **The home's day check needs no second "day ended?" check on show:** the existing foreground handler (`CalendarHome.tsx:501-519`) already drops the store when the day ended while the tab was away. So the timer, when it fires hidden, only re-arms itself on the next show (`afterShown(arm)`), and never resets or refetches. (A first version ran the check on show too and asked the server twice; the smoke #27b pins "one reset, no second request".)
9. **`hasTelegram` is a new field on the dashboard's wire props** (`DashboardPageProps.hasTelegram: boolean`, `user.telegramId !== null`) and on `CalendarHomeProps` as optional (absent = unknown = no banner). `smoke-page-auth` pins the dashboard's exact key list; step 2 adds the key.
10. `send.signedOut` ("Please reopen FamCal from the chat and try again.") is left as it is; see the open question at the end. No sender is added or changed, so `scripts/smoke-pause.ts` needs no entry (the route is already in `NOT_PAUSED`).

```ts
// Smoke test for the fixes the web makes visible (web sign-in spec
// docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-02-web-sign-in-design.md §2.14; plan Task 10).
//
// What it pins:
//   - Send to chat follows the session's sign-in method (resolveCommandTargetOrReason): a
//     'wa' session (the WhatsApp link, and any cookie from before web sign-in) answers on
//     WhatsApp; a Telegram, Google or email session answers on Telegram, also for an account
//     that has both chats; a WhatsApp-only account signed in another way gets 'wa_link_needed'
//     (WhatsApp refuses free replies after 24 hours); Telegram initData and the operator
//     answer on Telegram. The sheet names the chat the route used.
//   - "Open FamCal in Telegram" shows in a browser only to a WhatsApp-only account
//     (hasTelegram === false); an account with Telegram, or one nobody told, never sees it.
//   - The admin entry in the menu shows only inside Telegram.
//   - The Calendars screen's copy poll and the home's day check wait while the tab is hidden
//     and take up again on show (src/lib/visibility-timers.ts, a pure helper with its clock,
//     visibility and show-subscription injected).
//   - The wiring: the screens use the helper (no setInterval left), the no-access card links
//     to the sign-in page, the route returns the platform and the refusal reason.
//   - A dead cookie never loops (Review Focus RF4): the no-access card's Sign in is a plain link to
//     /signin with no user_id or redirect parameter, nothing in PageGate sends the browser to /signin by
//     itself, and the card is reached only from a 401, 403 or 404 answer. (The cookie's clearing and
//     "the next visit gets the card, not another round" are pinned by smoke-web-session #6, #7 and #8,
//     Task 2; "a 401 asks nothing more" by smoke-calendar-home-render #28.)
//   - The new strings exist in he, en and ru.
//
// Nothing is faked beyond the helper's injected deps: no DB, Redis or network.
//
// Run with the fake env (never the real one), from the repo root:
//   bash <scratchpad>/6b/run-smoke.sh smoke-web-fixes

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
type Row = Record<string, any>;

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');

type Result = { name: string; ok: boolean; reason?: string };
const results: Result[] = [];

async function check(name: string, fn: () => void | Promise<void>) {
  try {
    await fn();
    results.push({ name, ok: true });
  } catch (err) {
    results.push({ name, ok: false, reason: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) });
  }
}

function assert(cond: unknown, message: string): asserts cond {
  if (!cond) throw new Error(message);
}

const show = (value: unknown) => JSON.stringify(value);
const load = (rel: string): Promise<Row> => import(path.join(ROOT, rel));
const source = (rel: string) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, rel), 'utf8');
const messagesOf = (locale: string): Row => JSON.parse(source(`messages/${locale}.json`));

/** A user row as the command target reads it. */
const account = (o: { telegramId?: number | null; whatsappPhone?: string | null; whatsappBsuid?: string | null }): Row => ({
  telegramId: null,
  whatsappPhone: null,
  whatsappBsuid: null,
  ...o,
});
const BOTH = account({ telegramId: 111111111, whatsappPhone: '972500000001' });
const TG_ONLY = account({ telegramId: 222222222 });
const WA_PHONE = account({ whatsappPhone: '972500000002' });
const WA_BSUID = account({ whatsappBsuid: 'IL.123' });
const NONE = account({});

const HOME = 'app/[locale]/(app)/dashboard';

async function main() {
  await check('#1 the chat follows the session: a wa session answers on WhatsApp; tg, google and email sessions on Telegram; a WhatsApp-only account signed in another way is told to use WhatsApp\'s link', async () => {
    const { resolveCommandTargetOrReason: resolve, resolveCommandTarget } = await load('src/lib/command-target.ts');
    const tg = (chatId: number) => ({ ok: true, target: { platform: 'telegram', chatId } });
    const wa = (chatId: string) => ({ ok: true, target: { platform: 'whatsapp', chatId } });
    const no = (reason: string) => ({ ok: false, reason });
    // [name, user, via, method, want]
    const table: [string, Row, string, string | null | undefined, Row][] = [
      ['wa link, both chats', BOTH, 'session', 'wa', wa('972500000001')],
      ['wa link, WhatsApp phone only', WA_PHONE, 'session', 'wa', wa('972500000002')],
      ['wa link, BSUID only', WA_BSUID, 'session', 'wa', wa('IL.123')],
      ['a cookie from before web sign-in (no method) counts as wa', WA_BSUID, 'session', undefined, wa('IL.123')],
      ['wa link, Telegram-only account', TG_ONLY, 'session', 'wa', tg(222222222)],
      ['tg session, both chats', BOTH, 'session', 'tg', tg(111111111)],
      ['google session, both chats', BOTH, 'session', 'google', tg(111111111)],
      ['email session, both chats', BOTH, 'session', 'email', tg(111111111)],
      ['google session, Telegram-only', TG_ONLY, 'session', 'google', tg(222222222)],
      ['google session, WhatsApp phone only', WA_PHONE, 'session', 'google', no('wa_link_needed')],
      ['email session, BSUID only', WA_BSUID, 'session', 'email', no('wa_link_needed')],
      ['tg session, WhatsApp-only', WA_PHONE, 'session', 'tg', no('wa_link_needed')],
      ['email session, no chat at all', NONE, 'session', 'email', no('no_channel')],
      ['wa session, no chat at all', NONE, 'session', 'wa', no('no_channel')],
      ['telegram initData, both chats', BOTH, 'telegram', null, tg(111111111)],
      ['telegram initData ignores a method', BOTH, 'telegram', 'wa', tg(111111111)],
      ['operator, Telegram account', TG_ONLY, 'server', null, tg(222222222)],
      ['operator, WhatsApp-only: as before, no chat', WA_PHONE, 'server', null, no('no_channel')],
    ];
    const wrong: string[] = [];
    for (const [name, user, via, method, want] of table) {
      const got = resolve(user, via, method);
      if (show(got) !== show(want)) wrong.push(`${name}: ${show(got)}, want ${show(want)}`);
      // The older call (target or null) agrees
      const plain = resolveCommandTarget(user, via, method);
      if (show(plain) !== show(want.ok ? want.target : null)) wrong.push(`${name}: resolveCommandTarget ${show(plain)}`);
    }
    assert(wrong.length === 0, wrong.join('; '));
  });

  await check('#2 the sheet names the chat the route used, and the WhatsApp hint is a problem line', async () => {
    const { sendResultKey } = await load(`${HOME}/SendSheet.tsx`);
    const table: [Row, Row | null][] = [
      [{ outcome: 'closing' }, null],
      [{ outcome: 'sent', chat: 'whatsapp' }, { key: 'send.sentWhatsApp', problem: false }],
      [{ outcome: 'sent', chat: 'telegram' }, { key: 'send.sentTelegram', problem: false }],
      [{ outcome: 'sent', chat: 'unknown' }, { key: 'send.sent', problem: false }],
      [{ outcome: 'failed', status: 400, reason: 'wa_link_needed' }, { key: 'send.waLinkNeeded', problem: true }],
      [{ outcome: 'failed', status: 400 }, { key: 'send.failed', problem: true }],
      [{ outcome: 'failed', status: 401 }, { key: 'send.signedOut', problem: true }],
      [{ outcome: 'failed', status: null }, { key: 'send.offline', problem: true }],
      [{ outcome: 'busy' }, { key: 'send.busy', problem: true }],
    ];
    const wrong = table.filter(([result, want]) => show(sendResultKey(result)) !== show(want)).map(([result]) => show(result));
    assert(wrong.length === 0, `wrong lines for ${wrong.join(', ')}`);
  });

  await check('#3 Open FamCal in Telegram: only a WhatsApp-only account (hasTelegram false) in a browser', async () => {
    const { homeBanners } = await load(`${HOME}/HomeBanners.tsx`);
    const base = { googleState: 'none', googleConnected: false, reconnect: null };
    const ids = (facts: Row) => homeBanners({ ...base, ...facts });
    assert(show(ids({ inTelegram: false, hasTelegram: false })) === show(['openInTelegram']), `WhatsApp-only in a browser: ${show(ids({ inTelegram: false, hasTelegram: false }))}`);
    assert(show(ids({ inTelegram: false, hasTelegram: true })) === show([]), 'an account with Telegram in a browser: none');
    assert(show(ids({ inTelegram: false })) === show([]), 'unknown in a browser: none');
    assert(show(ids({ inTelegram: true, hasTelegram: false })) === show([]), 'inside Telegram: none');
    assert(show(ids({ inTelegram: true, hasTelegram: true })) === show([]), 'inside Telegram with Telegram: none');
    // The other banners keep their order around it
    assert(show(ids({ inTelegram: false, hasTelegram: false, trialDaysLeft: 3, hasLocation: false })) === show(['trial', 'location', 'openInTelegram']), 'order');
  });

  await check('#4 the admin entry shows only inside Telegram', async () => {
    const { menuEntries } = await load(`${HOME}/MenuSheet.tsx`);
    const ids = (o: Row) => menuEntries({ googleState: 'connected', locale: 'en', userId: 7, ...o }).map((e: Row) => e.id);
    assert(ids({ isAdmin: true, inTelegram: true }).includes('admin'), 'an admin inside Telegram has it');
    assert(!ids({ isAdmin: true, inTelegram: false }).includes('admin'), 'an admin in a browser does not');
    assert(!ids({ isAdmin: false, inTelegram: true }).includes('admin'), 'a non-admin never does');
    assert(show(ids({ isAdmin: true, inTelegram: false })) === show(ids({ isAdmin: false, inTelegram: true })), 'nothing else changes');
  });

  /** A count read through a call, so TypeScript does not narrow it after an assertion. */
  function counter() {
    let n = 0;
    return { bump: () => { n++; }, get: () => n };
  }

  /** A scripted clock, visibility and show-subscription for the helper. */
  function world() {
    let now = 0;
    let seq = 0;
    let hidden = false;
    const timers: { id: number; at: number; run: () => void }[] = [];
    const waiting: (() => void)[] = [];
    const deps = {
      isHidden: () => hidden,
      onceVisible: (cb: () => void) => {
        const fire = () => {
          const i = waiting.indexOf(fire);
          if (i >= 0) waiting.splice(i, 1);
          cb();
        };
        waiting.push(fire);
        return () => {
          const i = waiting.indexOf(fire);
          if (i >= 0) waiting.splice(i, 1);
        };
      },
      setTimer: (run: () => void, ms: number) => {
        const id = ++seq;
        timers.push({ id, at: now + ms, run });
        return () => {
          const i = timers.findIndex((t) => t.id === id);
          if (i >= 0) timers.splice(i, 1);
        };
      },
    };
    return {
      deps,
      /** How many timers and show-listeners are pending (a call, so a check never narrows it). */
      n: () => ({ timers: timers.length, waiting: waiting.length }),
      advance: (ms: number) => {
        const end = now + ms;
        for (;;) {
          timers.sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at || a.id - b.id);
          const next = timers[0];
          if (!next || next.at > end) break;
          timers.shift();
          now = next.at;
          next.run();
        }
        now = end;
      },
      hide: () => {
        hidden = true;
      },
      show: () => {
        hidden = false;
        waiting.slice().forEach((fire) => fire());
      },
    };
  }

  await check('#5 the poll runs while the tab shows, stops (no timer left, one show-listener) while it is hidden, and takes up again one interval after the tab shows', async () => {
    const { startVisiblePoll } = await load('src/lib/visibility-timers.ts');
    const w = world();
    const hits = counter();
    const stop = startVisiblePoll(() => hits.bump(), 10_000, w.deps);
    w.advance(35_000);
    assert(hits.get() === 3, `three polls while visible: ${hits.get()}`);
    w.hide();
    w.advance(10_000);
    assert(hits.get() === 3 && w.n().timers === 0 && w.n().waiting === 1, `hidden: ${show({ polls: hits.get(), ...w.n() })}`);
    w.advance(3_600_000);
    assert(hits.get() === 3 && w.n().timers === 0, `an hour hidden: ${show({ polls: hits.get(), ...w.n() })}`);
    w.show();
    assert(hits.get() === 3 && w.n().timers === 1 && w.n().waiting === 0, `shown: the page's own handler refreshes; the poll waits a full interval: ${show({ polls: hits.get(), ...w.n() })}`);
    w.advance(10_000);
    assert(hits.get() === 4, `then it polls again: ${hits.get()}`);
    stop();
    assert(w.n().timers === 0 && w.n().waiting === 0, 'stop clears the timer');
    w.advance(100_000);
    assert(hits.get() === 4, 'and nothing polls after it');
    // A stop while hidden takes the show-listener back too
    const w2 = world();
    const hits2 = counter();
    const stop2 = startVisiblePoll(() => hits2.bump(), 10_000, w2.deps);
    w2.hide();
    w2.advance(10_000);
    assert(w2.n().waiting === 1, 'waiting for the tab');
    stop2();
    assert(w2.n().waiting === 0, 'stop while hidden removes the listener');
    w2.show();
    w2.advance(100_000);
    assert(hits2.get() === 0 && w2.n().timers === 0, 'and a later show starts nothing');
  });

  await check('#6 afterShown goes now when the tab shows and on the next show when hidden; cancel takes it back; the browser deps never report hidden without a document', async () => {
    const { afterShown, DOM_VISIBILITY } = await load('src/lib/visibility-timers.ts');
    const w = world();
    const hits = counter();
    afterShown(() => hits.bump(), w.deps);
    assert(hits.get() === 1, 'visible: now');
    w.hide();
    const cancel = afterShown(() => hits.bump(), w.deps);
    assert(hits.get() === 1 && w.n().waiting === 1, 'hidden: waits');
    cancel();
    w.show();
    assert(hits.get() === 1, 'cancelled: never');
    afterShown(() => hits.bump(), w.deps);
    w.hide();
    afterShown(() => hits.bump(), w.deps);
    w.show();
    assert(hits.get() === 3, `the one that waited goes on show: ${hits.get()}`);
    assert((globalThis as Row).document === undefined, 'this smoke has no document');
    assert(DOM_VISIBILITY.isHidden() === false, 'no document: the tab is never hidden');
    const late = counter();
    DOM_VISIBILITY.onceVisible(() => late.bump())();
    assert(late.get() === 1, 'no document: onceVisible calls back at once');
  });

  await check('#7 the wiring: the Calendars poll and the home\'s day check use the helper; the no-access card, the route and the dashboard carry the new facts', async () => {
    const calendars = source('app/[locale]/(app)/calendars/CalendarsClient.tsx');
    assert(/startVisiblePoll\(/.test(calendars) && !/setInterval\(/.test(calendars), 'CalendarsClient: startVisiblePoll, no setInterval');
    const home = source(`${HOME}/CalendarHome.tsx`);
    assert(/DOM_VISIBILITY\.isHidden\(\)/.test(home) && /afterShown\(arm\)/.test(home), 'CalendarHome: the day check waits while hidden');
    assert(/hasTelegram=\{hasTelegram\}/.test(home), 'CalendarHome passes hasTelegram to the banners');
    assert(/isAdmin=\{user\.isAdmin\}\s*\n\s*inTelegram=\{inTelegram\}/.test(home), 'CalendarHome passes inTelegram to the menu');
    const gate = source('app/[locale]/(app)/PageGate.tsx');
    assert(/signInHref\(locale\)/.test(gate) && /hasTelegram: p\.hasTelegram/.test(gate), 'PageGate: the card links to sign-in, the home gets hasTelegram');
    const pageData = source('src/lib/page-data.ts');
    assert(/hasTelegram: user\.telegramId !== null/.test(pageData), 'page-data sends hasTelegram');
    const route = source('app/api/execute-command/route.ts');
    assert(/resolveCommandTargetOrReason\(user, via, method\)/.test(route) && /error: resolved\.reason/.test(route) && /^\s*platform,$/m.test(route), 'the route resolves by method, answers the reason and names the platform');
    assert(/auth\.via === 'session' \? auth\.session\.method : null/.test(route), 'the method is the session\'s');
  });

  await check('#8 the card\'s sign-in link is signInHref (the one /signin builder, src/site/signin.ts): the page\'s language, en has no prefix, an unknown language is en; this task adds no builder of its own', async () => {
    const { signInHref } = await load('src/site/signin.ts');
    const got = ['en', 'he', 'ru', 'xx'].map((l) => signInHref(l));
    assert(show(got) === show(['/signin', '/he/signin', '/ru/signin', '/signin']), show(got));
    assert(!fs.existsSync(path.join(ROOT, 'src/lib/signin-link.ts')), 'src/lib/signin-link.ts must not exist: signInHref is the only /signin path builder');
    // Client-safe (the client card imports it): its value imports are the path helper and the locale normaliser only; anything else is a type
    const imports = source('src/site/signin.ts').match(/^import .*$/gm) ?? [];
    const clientSafe = (line: string) => /^import type /.test(line) || /from '@\/src\/site\/zmanim\/links';$/.test(line) || /from '@\/src\/utils\/locale';$/.test(line);
    assert(imports.length > 0 && imports.every(clientSafe), `src/site/signin.ts imports more than localeHref, normalizeLocale and types: ${show(imports.filter((l) => !clientSafe(l)))}`);
  });

  await check('#9 the new strings are in he, en and ru, and read as written for the language', async () => {
    const wrong: string[] = [];
    for (const locale of ['en', 'he', 'ru']) {
      const m = messagesOf(locale);
      const sentTelegram = m.calendarHome?.send?.sentTelegram;
      const waLinkNeeded = m.calendarHome?.send?.waLinkNeeded;
      const signIn = m.pageGate?.signIn;
      for (const [key, value] of [['send.sentTelegram', sentTelegram], ['send.waLinkNeeded', waLinkNeeded], ['pageGate.signIn', signIn]] as const) {
        if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.trim()) wrong.push(`${locale} has no ${key}`);
      }
      if (typeof waLinkNeeded === 'string' && (!/WhatsApp|וואטסאפ/.test(waLinkNeeded) || !/settings/.test(waLinkNeeded))) wrong.push(`${locale} waLinkNeeded: ${waLinkNeeded}`);
      for (const value of [sentTelegram, waLinkNeeded, signIn]) {
        // No slash or bracket gender forms in Hebrew or Russian
        if (locale !== 'en' && typeof value === 'string' && /[(\[][^)\]]*[)\]]|\S\/\S/.test(value)) wrong.push(`${locale} gender form: ${value}`);
      }
    }
    // Each is different per language (not copied across)
    const en = messagesOf('en');
    const he = messagesOf('he');
    const ru = messagesOf('ru');
    if (he.pageGate.signIn === en.pageGate.signIn || ru.pageGate.signIn === en.pageGate.signIn) wrong.push('pageGate.signIn is not translated');
    if (!/טלגרם/.test(he.calendarHome.send.sentTelegram) || !/Telegram/.test(ru.calendarHome.send.sentTelegram)) wrong.push('sentTelegram names Telegram in its own language');
    assert(wrong.length === 0, wrong.join('; '));
  });

  await check('#10 a revoked, expired or signed-out cookie never loops between the card, /signin and /dashboard: the card\'s Sign in is a plain /signin link with no user_id or redirect parameter, and PageGate never sends the browser to /signin by itself', async () => {
    const { signInHref } = await load('src/site/signin.ts');
    for (const locale of ['en', 'he', 'ru']) {
      const href = signInHref(locale);
      assert(!/[?#]|user_id|next=|redirect/.test(href), `${locale}: the card\'s link carries state: ${href}`);
    }
    const gate = source('app/[locale]/(app)/PageGate.tsx');
    // Exactly one use: the card's action. A second one would be a redirect the gate makes on its own.
    assert((gate.match(/signInHref\(/g) ?? []).length === 1 && /\{ label: t\('signIn'\), primary: true, href: signInHref\(locale\) \}/.test(gate), 'PageGate uses signInHref once, as the card\'s Sign in action');
    assert(!/router\.(push|replace)\([^)]*signin/i.test(gate) && !/location\.(href|assign|replace)[^;\n]*signin/i.test(gate), 'PageGate never navigates to /signin by itself');
    // The card is the answer to a refusal and nothing else: it is shown for 401, 403 and 404, and the answer is not retried.
    assert(/res\.status === 401 \|\| res\.status === 403 \|\| res\.status === 404/.test(gate) && /kind: 'gate'/.test(gate), 'PageGate shows the card for 401, 403 and 404 only');
    // The in-Telegram card keeps closing the Mini App: no Sign in, so a Telegram session never reaches /signin from here.
    assert(/if \(inTelegram\) \{/.test(gate) && gate.indexOf('if (inTelegram) {') < gate.indexOf('signInHref(locale)'), 'NoCredentialCard branches on inTelegram before the browser card');
  });

  let failed = 0;
  for (const r of results) {
    console.log(`${r.ok ? 'OK' : 'FAIL'}  ${r.name}${r.ok ? '' : ` — ${r.reason}`}`);
    if (!r.ok) failed++;
  }
  console.log(`\n${results.length - failed}/${results.length} passed (process TZ=${process.env.TZ ?? 'unset'})`);
  process.exit(failed ? 1 : 0);
}

main().catch((err) => {
  console.error(err);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

```ts
/** A session cookie as web sign-in mints it: the user, how they signed in, and now. */
async function sessionCookie(userId: number, method: 'tg' | 'google' | 'email' | 'wa'): Promise<string> {
  const { createSessionToken, SESSION_COOKIE_NAME } = await load('src/lib/session-auth.ts');
  return `${SESSION_COOKIE_NAME}=${createSessionToken(userId, method, Date.now())}`;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Create the visibility helper**

`src/lib/visibility-timers.ts` (new; pure, client-safe, no imports):

```ts
/**
 * Timers that wait while the tab is hidden (spec 2026-11-02 web sign-in §2.14). A browser tab left open
 * in the background must not keep Neon awake: the Calendars screen's copy poll and the home's day check
 * ask the server, so while document.visibilityState is 'hidden' they stop and take up again on show.
 *
 * Pure: the clock, the visibility and the "next time it shows" subscription come in as `deps`, so a smoke
 * can drive them. DOM_VISIBILITY is the real browser; with no `document` (the server, a smoke) the tab is
 * never hidden, so everything behaves as a plain timer.
 */

export interface VisibilityDeps {
  /** True while the tab is in the background. */
  isHidden: () => boolean;
  /** Calls `cb` once, the next time the tab shows; the returned function takes it back. */
  onceVisible: (cb: () => void) => () => void;
  /** A timer; the returned function cancels it. */
  setTimer: (run: () => void, ms: number) => () => void;
}

export const DOM_VISIBILITY: VisibilityDeps = {
  isHidden: () => typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.visibilityState === 'hidden',
  onceVisible: (cb) => {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined') {
      cb();
      return () => {};
    }
    const onChange = () => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') return;
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onChange);
      cb();
    };
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onChange);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onChange);
  },
  setTimer: (run, ms) => {
    const id = setTimeout(run, ms);
    return () => clearTimeout(id);
  },
};

/** Runs `run` now when the tab shows, else once it next shows. Returns the cancel. */
export function afterShown(run: () => void, deps: VisibilityDeps = DOM_VISIBILITY): () => void {
  if (!deps.isHidden()) {
    run();
    return () => {};
  }
  return deps.onceVisible(run);
}

/**
 * Calls `run` every `ms` while the tab shows. A tick that finds the tab hidden does not run and sets no
 * further timer; the poll takes up again, one full `ms` after the tab shows (the screen's own
 * visibilitychange handler has already refreshed by then). Returns the stop.
 */
export function startVisiblePoll(run: () => void, ms: number, deps: VisibilityDeps = DOM_VISIBILITY): () => void {
  let stopped = false;
  let cancel = () => {};
  const arm = () => {
    cancel = deps.setTimer(() => {
      if (stopped) return;
      if (deps.isHidden()) {
        cancel = afterShown(arm, deps);
        return;
      }
      run();
      arm();
    }, ms);
  };
  arm();
  return () => {
    stopped = true;
    cancel();
  };
}
```
